# W3C Standard

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A standard or recommendation published by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).

## Scope note

Covers the semantic web standards underlying this vocabulary - SKOS, OWL, RDF - as a class distinct from ISO standards.
